title: Harden accessory instance slot and handedness validation
description: Harden accessory instance validation so an omitted instance equipment slot defaults to the template's declared slot, omitted instance handedness resolves to the template's declared handedness, and a guarded two-handed-template path validates before any two-handed template can be registered; wire the hardened validation into the public equip/replace/swap-hand/recolor/unequip operations.
deviation_notes: New track retires two Open tech-debt items left by the completed character_accessory_library track: Medium 'Omitted compatible slots allow an instance override - default to the template slot in assembly validation before exposing S3 equipment operations' and Low 'Omitted handedness conflicts with two-handed metadata - normalize omitted instance handedness before adding one.' Validation is mechanical and not blocked by the pending visual acceptance gates. The seventeen registered templates, four reference loadouts, and sword-and-shield regression must remain compatible.

sprint.goal: Make accessory instance slot and handedness resolution deterministic and template-bound before any two-handed template is added.

stories.title: Default omitted compatible slots to the template slot
Normalize omitted instance handedness against template metadata
